title: Attribute types and enumeration values are different levels
goal: Read actual metadata types and distinguish the Новая enumeration value from identically named text.
prerequisites: onec.p3; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Locate Клиент, ДлительностьМинут and Статус types in Designer.
Inspect metadata through BSL without changing records.
Separate allowed state values from allowed state transitions.
sections: New, InProgress andClosed are developer-defined states changed through configuration, so an enumeration suits them. User-maintained services suit a catalog. Do not choose enumeration merely because today’s list is short; consider who changes it and how.

The function reads document attributes and two type descriptions. СодержитТип checks permitted customer-reference and numeric types. ТипЗнч separately examines the actual Новая value as ПеречислениеСсылка.СтатусыЗаявки. The string "Новая" remains text despite a familiar caption.

A new request may default toNew; an older missing status may need handling. Never silently treat empty asClosed. Distinguish absence, an allowed enumeration value and a similar-looking string. Strong typing helps, but transition correctness remains an application rule.

Separate a field’s permitted type, a variable’s actual value type and a domain constraint. A number does not prove the 0..1440 range, and an enumeration type does not prove a legal transition from a closed state. This experiment inspects types without changing existing statuses or validation.

New → InProgress andInProgress → Closed may be allowed; Closed → New may require a special command. Enforce the allowed-pair table centrally, not only through button availability. Adding a state requires updating transitions, filters, reports and tests or the new value may be mishandled.

Enumeration values are defined by the configuration developer. Users select them instead of creating catalog-like items. User-configurable states require another model and integrity rules. Do not delete referenced enumeration values just to change a caption.

After changing enumeration values, check existing documents and saved report settings. Renaming an element technically differs from relabeling its synonym. Do not delete an in-use value for cosmetic reasons. Preserve prior references and test an invalid transition without a write.

All four original expectations are true. The incorrect control asks for String instead of Number for minutes: it compiles but its claim is false. That tests expected-type meaning, not a complete migration, status-transition graph or all stored data.
